profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Iron Galaxy Studios
profile.summary:
Thien Nguyen (Senior Software Engineer) joined Iron Galaxy Orlando in Fall 2013.  Previously, he served as a lead software engineer for the NCAA Football franchise, with his focus being to drive shared development initiatives across the football business unit.  He has over 10 years of industry experience developing high quality interactive entertainment while serving in a senior leadership role delivering those products.  He has expertise in all technical aspects of game development for consoles as well as technical process development to ensure timely delivery of projects.  
 
He is passionate about games, quality, innovation and above all, taking care of the people he works with.  He strives to push the limits on how technology can improve games across all platforms as well as the process we use to deliver those experiences.  
 
Thien holds a Master’s of Science and Bachelors of Science (with concentration in computer science) from the University of Florida.  
 
Specialties: C, C++, large scale system architecture, extensible system design, system metric analysis, multithreaded development, performance optimization on consoles, Scrum project management, developing technical development plans

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led architecture realignment effort for flight software project for the FAA.  Transition old codebase technology to a object oriented design to consolidate core functionality and ensure conforming designs for future implementations.  

Led IRAD (Independent Research and Development) effort for FAA flight software to detect flight hazards in flight planning software.  

Worked on flight control software contract to update flight management software for FAA.
